critical_code_review_comments: LocFaq.jsx – elegant fallback: if content.location_faq_template.faqs is missing (e.g. before migration runs), falls back to loc.faqs. Both paths use dot-notation edit paths so the Editable component saves to the correct location. The `substitute(str) = str.replace(/\{name\}/g, name)` handles multiple placeholders per string. In edit mode the RAW template is shown so admins won't accidentally hard-code a location name.

The review request mentions [data-testid=admin-edit-toggle] but the actual testid is [data-testid=toolbar-toggle-edit]. Editing is on by default after login so this discrepancy did not block testing. Consider aligning the spec or adding an alias.

About.jsx dog slot: the slot is only conditionally rendered when editMode || dog_photo_url. Nice touch: uses EditableImage(path='about.dog_photo_url') + Editable(path=`about.dog_caption_${lang}`) which participates in the same PATCH batching.

seeds/defaults.py – location_faq_template is added to DEFAULT_CONTENT AFTER its declaration; upsert-only seed logic must ensure existing DBs get the template on next startup. Verified live: /api/content already contains the template with 15 FAQs on preview env.

default_pages.py _build_location now sets exam_routes_title_de='Hier fahren wir' unconditionally. seeds/startup.py migration step handles the case where existing docs still had 'Typische Prüfungsstrecken' — verified: all 17 locations now return 'Hier fahren wir'.
